user_agents.name: Claude-Agent
user_agents.purpose: Used in Claude Duet by Anthropic-hosted browsers completing tasks for users.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for generative AI model development and training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites in response to user questions directed to Claude.

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl web pages for Google search indexes and other products.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images for Google products and Search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and Search features presenting images, logos, and favicons.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for video-related Google Search features.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for the Google News product.

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Perform crawls for Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Testing tools such as the Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for internal research, development, and team fetching.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content across sites for various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for various product teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs; does not affect specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using user-agent GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for various product teams.
